task: Training-free task-guided cropping framework for improving fine-grained perception of MLLMs under fixed-resolution vision encoders.
named_method_commitments: cropping / zoom-in on salient local regions
integration of local detail with global context for answer generation
comparison against baseline fixed-resolution MLLM behavior
evidence through small-object / fine-grained cases and attention-style localization
primary_outputs_expected: comparison plots between baseline and crop-enhanced pipeline
quantitative proxy metrics for information recovery on demo images
current_scope_note: Workspace contains only demo imagery rather than full benchmark data, so the study will implement a faithful image-analysis proxy of the named mechanism rather than full MLLM evaluation.
